Flivver Lo-V.name: Flivver Lo-V
Flivver Lo-V.description: The popularity of the Flivver has led to Lionheart producing a special version called the Flivver Lo-V. This model is not capable of hyperspace travel, nor is it particularly strong, but it is incredibly fast, and a favourite for intrastellar day-trippers. The outfit scanner that comes in the place of a shield generator is enjoyed by rich children all over the galaxy, although it is also often a pain for law enforcement.

Hyperlight Shuttle.name: Hyperlight Shuttle
Hyperlight Shuttle.description: The Betelgeuse Shipyards Shuttle has always been popular, and recently they have come out with a new variant on the classic. Although the Hyperlight Shuttle lacks a hyperdrive, it is extraordinarily fast due to its polished hull and atomic engines, and an excellent new take on a traditional favourite.

Partisan.name: Partisan
Partisan.description: When the Navy retires old fighters, they occasionally are sold on the civilian market as pleasure craft. These modified Lances, known as "Partisans," are not able to carry passengers like other pleasure craft, nor can they mount guns like a traditional Lance. Paired with the removal of some of their armour plating and the addition of the latest atomic engines, this makes them exceptionally manueverable - albeit not very survivable in combat.

Modified Eagle 🇲.name: Modified Eagle 🇲
Modified Eagle 🇲.description: Ever since the Tarazed Falcon was released, starship captains across the galaxy have argued over whether it or the Betelgeuse Leviathan is a better ship. After some arguments got out of hand, Greenrock Shipyards, Ltd. produced a new ship from the parts of the Falcon and Leviathan, complete with a big cannon in the front. Most of the time, the cannon is just a normal gun, but with some modifications, it can be used as a spinal mount. This ship has those modifications, along with some other ones.
